verdict.rationale: Crossmint is documented as API-first. Wallets are offered through a single API that handles every wallet operation. The headless checkout REST APIs mirror the embedded iframe UI with full control of the experience, and onramp, offramp and agent cards and checkouts each have API endpoints and an interactive API reference. However, nothing documents parity with the dashboard or console: project setup, API key management and policy configuration via API are not shown. No public OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths, and agent checkouts lack webhooks in v1. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of dashboard and admin functions, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
